//: Dogfooding config: this repo runs its OWN build, not the published package. Pointing this at `npx engram-mcp-server` means local fixes are never exercised by the live server — which is how audit N3 stayed observable for four unprompted incidents while a fix sat in dist/. Run `npm run build` after changing src/, then reload the MCP server. Switch back to npx only to verify a release.
